_instruction: Drug Product Description — reconstitution diluent only. If none, state clearly (e.g. Not applicable).

components.title: Accompanying reconstitution diluent(s)
components.prompt: ESSENCE: Describe any diluent supplied for reconstitution (name, strength, volume, container). CONTRACT: If the product is not reconstituted before use (e.g. solid oral dosage form without diluent), output a concise statement such as 'Not applicable' or 'No reconstitution diluent is supplied.' Do not invent diluent details. SOURCE: technical_intelligence.p1 reconstitution/diluent fields when present.
